title: Filter a dashboard from a graph

blocks.content: You can filter a whole dashboard straight from a graph: click a series and choose **Filter on this value** or **Filter out this value**. In this guide you check what makes a panel filterable, group the dashboard by `job`, and then filter in and out from the graph.
Filter buttons only appear for fields that are marked filterable. To see how this panel is set up, complete the following steps:

blocks.title: Check that the panel is filterable

blocks.tooltip: This demo dashboard has a filter variable with group by turned on.

blocks.content: Open the **HTTP requests** panel menu and select **Edit**. Select **Run 2 steps** to have Pathfinder do them in order.

steps.tooltip: The menu button appears when you hover the panel title.
The panel editor opens with the panel options on the right.

blocks.content: This override matches every field with the regex `/.*/` and turns on **Filterable**. To set this up on your own panel, select **Add field override** > **Fields with name matching regex**, enter `.*`, then select **Add override property** > **Filterable** and turn it on.
blocks.tooltip: Filterable is only available as an override, not as a panel default.
The override stays in place until you discard or save the dashboard.

blocks.content: Every field on the **HTTP requests** panel is filterable.
The filter buttons use the labels you group by, so group the dashboard by `job` first:
In the **Group by** box, type `job` and select the **job** label.
blocks.tooltip: Group by sits next to the filters in the same control.

blocks.content: The graph now shows one line per job, and each line carries its `job` label.
To keep only one job, filter on it from the graph:
Click a line on the **HTTP requests** graph to pin its tooltip, then select **Filter on this value**.

steps.description: Click a line on the graph to pin its tooltip.
steps.tooltip: Clicking pins the tooltip so you can use its buttons.
This adds a job = filter for the line you clicked.

blocks.content: A `job =` filter for the line you clicked is now in the filter bar, and every panel shows only that job.
blocks.tooltip: Filter buttons add a filter for each grouped label of the series.

blocks.content: You filtered the dashboard to a single job from the graph.
To hide one job instead, remove the filter and filter it out:
Remove the `job =` filter to bring back every job.
Click a line on the **HTTP requests** graph to pin its tooltip, then select **Filter out this value**.

steps.description: Click a line on the graph to pin its tooltip.
steps.tooltip: Pick the job you want to hide.
This adds a job != filter for the line you clicked.

blocks.content: A `job !=` filter is now in the filter bar, and the job you clicked is gone from every panel.
blocks.tooltip: Click the pill to switch the operator or change the value.

blocks.content: You filtered in and out from a graph. These filters live in the URL, so you can share the filtered view by sharing the link.
